coverage_sections: Medical Records Documentation Used for Reviews

claude.note: The probe and the evaluation never call Claude (rules only). For a fresh run the configured model and prompt version are logged so a run that does use Claude can be reproduced; for a saved run they are 'not recorded' because that run did not log them.

meta.disclaimer: Small samples: these results are diagnostic only. They show where the rules behave well or badly on these examples, not how accurate the tool is in general.

rows.description: In the Applicable Codes intro, the older version read "is a covered or non-covered health service" (no space after the hyphen).

changes.label: cosmetic
changes.before_text: The following list(s) of procedure and/or diagnosis codes is provided for reference purposes only and may not be all inclusive. Listing of a code in this guideline does not imply that the service described by the code is a covered or non-covered health service. rows.description: In Medical Records Documentation, the older version read "Medical records documentation is required to assess whether the member meets the clinical criteria" (no "may be").

changes.label: ambiguous
changes.evidence: modal words ['may']; removed: is | added: may be
changes.path: Medical Records Documentation Used for Reviews
changes.before_text: Benefit coverage for health services is determined by the member specific benefit plan document and applicable laws that may require coverage for a specific service. Medical records documentation is required to assess whether the member meets the clinical criteria for coverage but does not guarantee coverage of the service requested; refer to the guidelines titled Medical Records Documentation Used for Reviews.
changes.after_text: Benefit coverage for health services is determined by the member specific benefit plan document and applicable laws that may require coverage for a specific service. Medical records documentation may be required to assess whether the member meets the clinical criteria for coverage but does not guarantee coverage of the service requested; refer to the guidelines titled Medical Records Documentation Used for Reviews.

rows.likely_cause: modal-word rule sends any may/should/must/will/can change to review, harmless or not. Sent to a human, so not missed, but the rules did not detect this substantive change on their own.

changes.after_text: This Medical Policy may also be applied to Medicare Advantage plans in certain instances. In the absence of a Medicare National Coverage Determination (NCD), Local Coverage Determination (LCD), or other Medicare coverage guidance, CMS allows a Medicare Advantage Organization (MAO) to create its own coverage determinations, using objective evidence-based rationale relying on authoritative evidence ( Medicare IOM Pub. No. 100-16, Ch. 4, §90.5).
